info.title: Clinical Co-Pilot — Agent API
info.description: HTTP surface of the Clinical Co-Pilot sidecar agent (Fastify). Documents EVERY route registered in `src/app.ts`. Route registration is CONDITIONAL: `/chat` needs an agent + a non-empty bridge secret; the `/documents/*` routes need an ingestion service + the bridge secret; `/dev/session-token` is dev-only (`devMint`); `/metrics`, `/dashboard`, `/alerts` need an ops token. All conditional routes fail CLOSED — when the required dependency/secret is absent the route is not registered at all (a 404), never an open door. Auth is a bearer token in every case except the always-on probes and the dev UI; there is NO cookie/CSRF auth on the agent. Schemas are derived from the Zod contracts the routes parse, not invented.

tags.name: chat
tags.description: Conversational agent turn (SSE). Token-bound patient scope.

tags.name: ops
tags.description: Operational metrics, dashboard, alerts — ops-token gated.

tags.description: DEV-ONLY helpers. Never registered in production.

SessionBearer.description: Boundary-#1 signed session token (HMAC). Minted by the OpenEMR bridge in prod (or `GET /dev/session-token` in dev). The bound patient (`patientFhirId`/`pid`) comes from this token — never from the request body. Verified (signature -> expiry -> shape) on every request. A confined `system:ingest` token is REJECTED (403) on these user routes.

SystemIngestBearer.description: A confined `subject: system:ingest` session token. Accepted ONLY by `POST /documents/extract`; a normal user token is rejected there (403), and this token is rejected (403) on every user/read route.

OpsBearer.description: Static ops token (constant-time compared). Gates `/metrics`, `/dashboard`, `/alerts`. May alternatively be supplied as a `?token=` query param (so a browser can auto-refresh the dashboard); the query value is redacted from logs.

status.description: `ready` = all checks pass; `degraded` = a non-critical dependency (e.g. RAG) failed but the core serves (still HTTP 200); `not_ready` = a critical dependency failed (HTTP 503).

ChatRequest.description: Multi-turn history. Any `patientId` a client sends is IGNORED — the patient is bound by the token (`.passthrough()` tolerates extra keys but nothing reads them).

IngestionStatus.description: Cheap detect-only status for the notification dot (no VLM call).

total.description: Pending documents detected for the bound patient.

ready.description: How many are extracted + cached, ready to review.

ReviewBox.description: Bounding box (normalized page coords) for the citation overlay. Absent when the value could not be tied to a tight box.

matchState.description: Box-match outcome: a tight box, a page-level 'approximate', or 'not found on page' (forced physician review). Never a silent fill.

ReviewDraft.description: One reviewable document draft. When `status` is `degraded`, `issues` is present and `results` is absent; when `ok`, `results` is present.

pageImageBase64.description: First page rasterized for the overlay (base64).

AlertsResponse.description: `alerts` lists EVERY defined rule (discoverable by name regardless of state); `firing` is the warning/critical subset; `status` is `firing` when any rule is firing else `ok`.

alerts.description: Every defined alert rule with its current status — includes the W2 rules extraction_failure_rate, rag_retrieval_latency, supervisor_hop_cap_rate, eval_regression_detection.

firing.description: The subset of `alerts` with status warning or critical, most severe first.

description.description: PHI-free: what the rule means + (when firing) specifics.

MetricsSnapshot.description: Live operational window (PHI-free: counts, latencies, tool/doc-type/route names only). Counters reset on restart; durable history lives in Langfuse. Shape is the `MetricsRegistry.snapshot()` DTO — a superset of the fields below (requests, latency percentiles, verification pass/fail, per-tool stats, W2 ingestion/retrieval/supervisor sections).

LabSeriesResponse.description: Absence-aware lab trend result. `documented:false` means no lab Observations are on file (never rendered as "normal"). When `documented:true`, `series` is one entry per test — the union of every committed extracted lab reading across all uploaded PDFs, grouped by test over its collection dates, each point traceable to its source document via `obsUuid`.

code.description: LOINC code when present, else the name used as the fallback group key.

value.description: Parsed numeric value plotted on the y-axis.

obsUuid.description: Observation uuid — traces the point to its source document (click-to-source).

Error.description: Generic error envelope. Never carries internal detail (SQL/paths/PHI) — the detail is logged with the correlation id. Unhandled errors additionally include `correlationId`.

CorrelationIdHeader.name: x-correlation-id
CorrelationIdHeader.description: Echoed if supplied, else generated. Threaded through every log line and returned on the response.

Forbidden.description: Valid token, but the wrong principal for this route (e.g. a system-ingest token on a user route, or a user token on the extract trigger).

CorsPreflight.description: CORS preflight. 204 No Content; CORS headers set only when the request Origin exactly matches the configured allowed origin.

get.description: Self-contained dev chat UI (no build step). Always registered.
Cheap liveness (no I/O). Always 200 while the process is up. Always registered, unauthenticated.

Read-only, unauthenticated opaque build id (a short commit sha) so external tooling can auto-stamp which build it tested and detect when the deployed build changes. Returns only the id, no branch/dependency detail. Always registered.

version.description: Opaque build id: COPILOT_VERSION env, else the git HEAD short sha, else "unknown".

get.description: Runs every registered dependency check. 200 for `ready` OR `degraded`; 503 for `not_ready`. Failing checks are named but carry no internal error text. Always registered, unauthenticated.

post.description: Multi-turn conversational endpoint. The patient is bound by the session token (verified every request); the pid never comes from the body. The verified answer streams back as Server-Sent Events: `data: {"delta":"…"}` frames, then a final `event: done` frame with `{ verdictOk, findings, ungrounded }`. Registered only when an agent + a non-empty bridge secret are configured (else 404).

200.description: SSE stream of the verified answer. Response header `x-correlation-id` is set.

get.description: Cheap detect-only status (NO VLM call), safe to poll on chart-open. Patient bound by the token. Registered only when an ingestion service + bridge secret are configured (else 404).

post.summary: Review drafts for the bound patient
post.description: Runs Week-2 ingestion for the bound patient and returns review drafts (extracted values + confidence + bounding boxes + page image for the overlay). Read-only: it proposes drafts, it never writes the chart. The body carries nothing patient-selecting. Registered only when an ingestion service + bridge secret are configured (else 404).

requestBody.description: No body is read — the patient comes from the token.

post.description: Server-to-server upload trigger: extract + cache the patient's pending docs, then return 202 immediately (extraction runs in the background; the physician reads results later via `/documents/pending`). NO CORS (never browser-reachable). Accepts ONLY a confined `system:ingest` token — a leaked/forged user token cannot reach it, and this token cannot reach any read path. Registered only when an ingestion service + bridge secret are configured (else 404).

202.description: Accepted; extraction runs in the background.

get.description: The live operational window as JSON (PHI-free). Ops-token gated (bearer or `?token=`). Registered only when a metrics registry + ops token are configured (else 404).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Ops token alternative to the Authorization header. Redacted from logs.

get.description: The same live window rendered as an auto-refreshing HTML page. Ops-token gated (bearer or `?token=`). Registered only when a metrics registry + ops token are configured (else 404).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Ops token alternative to the Authorization header. Redacted from logs.

get.description: Evaluates the metrics snapshot through the deterministic alert rule set; firing rules are logged structured. Ops-token gated (bearer or `?token=`). Registered only when a metrics registry + ops token are configured (else 404).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Ops token alternative to the Authorization header. Redacted from logs.

get.description: DEV-ONLY local stand-in for the OpenEMR `GET /copilot/session-token` bridge. Mints a signed session token for any `patientFhirId` — it does NOT enforce ownership, so it is acceptable only against synthetic local data. Registered solely when `devMint` is enabled; NEVER in production.

parameters.name: patientFhirId
parameters.description: The patient FHIR id to bind into the minted token.

503.description: Mint unavailable — the bridge secret is not configured.

post.summary: Lab trend series for the bound patient
post.description: Returns the bound patient's committed lab readings grouped into per-test time series — the data source for the trend-chart widget. The patient is fixed by the verified session token (the body carries nothing patient-selecting). Read-only, no LLM: a deterministic data view (like the review UI), so it does not pass the generation gate, but every point carries its Observation provenance (`obsUuid`) and the request is pid-bound + fail-closed. A confined `system:ingest` token is rejected (403) — this is a read path. Registered only when a lab-series reader + a non-empty bridge secret are configured (else 404).

requestBody.description: No body is read — the patient comes from the token.

200.description: Per-test lab time series (or `documented:false`). Header `x-correlation-id` is set.

502.description: Lab series read failure (generic — detail logged).
